content:
**base-branch is a required gate at lite and refuses a slice PR against main**

Implemented PR C (the gate) of #967: the base-branch governance check. Pure predicate checks/base-branch.mjs reuses parseGraphBlock (status/epic-graph.mjs) for the parent -> epic -> tracker grammar; a declared tracker requires the PR base to equal it, a tracker's own PR must target the default branch, and no-epic/no-parent/no-tracker all pass untouched (R967-7, R967-9). run-check.mjs's runBaseBranchCheck wraps it: fetches the linked issue and, only when it names a parent, the parent -- at most two issueView calls, never an issueList -- and fails closed (uncomputable) on a non-string PR body, an unresolvable target/default branch, a throwing fetchIssue, or an unreadable issue/graph-block, per the deny-reader rule (#942). Registered at all five sites: GOVERNANCE_JOBS, GATE_MATRIX (required at every tier including lite, ruling 1 -- a deliberate exception to lite-only-detects), both CI workflow files, and run-check.mjs's dispatch + SUBCOMMAND_PORT_REACH. Two doctrine drafts landed under brain-drafts/ for the maintainer: the lite-required exception plus the ratified tracker-PR-timing sentence (workflow-governance.md), and ADR-0032 Amendment 2 documenting the three new brain-graph/1 keys (kind, tracker, parent). Downstream fixes: contributor-scaffold.mjs's GATE_SUMMARY and the two regenerated PR/MR templates, and test/review-regulated/fixture.mjs's canned status rollup, both driven by the 11th governance job. Full suite 5659/5659, brain:repo:check green, no brain/core or brain/project paths touched.
